node.title: C36' admits a 145/4 shifted-energy close after identity separation
node.statement: For A=(1-H)\{0}, product and quotient multiplicities have equal L2 energy E_x(A), and N_3to1=sum_t P(t)R(t)=E_x(A)-(1/2)sum_t(P(t)-R(t))^2. The identity coordinate has R(1)=n-1 while the proved one-shift estimate gives P(1)<4n^(2/3). Keeping this compulsory separation proves that 4E_x(A)<=145(n-1)^2 implies N_3to1<36n^2-16n^(4/3)-n/2 on all 29 official orders. This strictly relaxes the former clean target E_x(A)<=35n^2, but does not prove the new energy premise or promote C36'.
